description: The figure contains two vertically stacked bar charts titled “mBERT” (top) and “XLM-R” (bottom) that illustrate, for each model, the “% point difference” between probing a single layer and probing a weighted sum of layers, with an additional category “concat” representing concatenation of all layers and layer “0” representing the embedding layer. In both panels, the categorical axis is horizontal: the top panel’s x-axis is labeled “XLM-R” and the bottom panel’s x-axis is labeled “layer”; in each case the categories appear in increasing numeric order from 0 through 12 followed by “concat,” with one bar per category. The value axis is vertical and labeled “% point difference,” shown on a linear scale with horizontal gridlines; in the mBERT panel the visible tick labels run from 0 down to about −10 in steps of 2 (0, −2, −4, −6, −8, −10) with the lowest bar extending slightly below −10, and in the XLM-R panel the ticks similarly span 0 to −10 in steps of 2. In the mBERT chart, all bars are a light blue with thin dark outlines: layer 0 is approximately −10.5, layer 1 about −8.6, layer 2 about −7.5, layer 3 about −5.0, layer 4 about −4.0, layer 5 about −2.4, layer 6 about −0.9, layer 7 about −0.8, layer 8 about −0.4, layer 9 is slightly above 0 (about +0.1), layer 10 is just above 0 (about +0.05), layer 11 is slightly below 0 (about −0.2), layer 12 about −1.2, and “concat” is slightly above 0 (about +0.4). In the XLM-R chart, all bars are a darker blue with thin outlines: layer 0 is about −9.6, layer 1 about −9.6, layer 2 about −8.2, layer 3 about −5.8, layer 4 about −3.5, layer 5 about −2.2, layer 6 about −0.6, layer 7 about −0.5, layer 8 about −0.6, layer 9 about −0.3, layer 10 slightly above 0 (about +0.3), layer 11 slightly above 0 (about +0.3), layer 12 slightly below 0 (about −0.2), and “concat” slightly above 0 (about +0.3). No legend is shown, the bars are not stacked or grouped beyond the single-series per panel, the ordering follows the layer index sequence rather than a sorted-by-value arrangement, and there are no special annotations or highlighted bars beyond the distinct color used for each model’s panel.
